title: 第8课 · 让我想想再告诉你
subtitle: HSK 2 · Lesson 8 — 让我想想再告诉你 · Let me think about it and I'll tell you later

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在教室 — In the classroom

items.zh: A：我们下午去看电影，好吗？
items.py: A: Wǒmen xiàwǔ qù kàn diànyǐng, hǎo ma?
items.en: A: Let's see a film this afternoon, shall we?

items.zh: B：今天下午我没有时间，明天下午再去吧。
items.py: B: Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān, míngtiān xiàwǔ zài qù ba.
items.en: B: I'm not free this afternoon. Let's go tomorrow afternoon.

items.py: A: Nǐ xiǎng kàn shénme diànyǐng?
items.en: A: Which film would you like to see?

items.py: B: Ràng wǒ xiǎngxiang zài gàosu nǐ.
items.en: B: Let me think about it and I'll tell you.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在宿舍 — In the dorm

items.zh: A：外边天气很好，我们出去运动运动吧！
items.py: A: Wàibian tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen chūqu yùndòng yùndòng ba!
items.en: A: It's a nice day. Let's go out and get some exercise!

items.zh: B：你等等我，好吗？王老师让我给大卫打个电话。
items.py: B: Nǐ děngdeng wǒ, hǎo ma? Wáng lǎoshī ràng wǒ gěi Dàwèi dǎ ge diànhuà.
items.en: B: Wait for me a minute? Teacher Wang asked me to call David.

items.zh: A：回来再打吧。找大卫有什么事情吗？
items.py: A: Huílai zài dǎ ba. Zhǎo Dàwèi yǒu shénme shìqing ma?
items.en: A: Call him when we're back. What's it about?

items.zh: B：听说大卫病了，我想找时间去看看他。
items.py: B: Tīngshuō Dàwèi bìng le, wǒ xiǎng zhǎo shíjiān qù kànkan tā.
items.en: B: I heard David's ill. I want to find time to visit him.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在宾馆的前台 — At the hotel front desk

items.zh: A：服务员，我房间的门打不开了。
items.py: A: Fúwùyuán, wǒ fángjiān de mén dǎ bu kāi le.
items.en: A: Excuse me, I can't open my door.

items.py: B: Nín zhù nǎge fángjiān?
items.en: B: Which room are you in?

items.py: A: Sān yāo qī.
items.en: A: Room 317.

items.py: B: Hǎo de, wǒ jiào rén qù kànkan.
items.en: B: OK, I'll send someone to have a look.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在商店 — In a store

items.zh: A：你看看这几件衣服怎么样。
items.py: A: Nǐ kànkan zhè jǐ jiàn yīfu zěnmeyàng.
items.en: A: Have a look at these dresses.

items.zh: B：这件白的有点儿长，那件黑的有点儿贵。
items.py: B: Zhè jiàn bái de yǒudiǎnr cháng, nà jiàn hēi de yǒudiǎnr guì.
items.en: B: This white one is a bit long, that black one is a bit expensive.

items.zh: A：这件红的呢？这是今天新来的。
items.py: A: Zhè jiàn hóng de ne? Zhè shì jīntiān xīn lái de.
items.en: A: What about this red one? It just came in today.

items.py: B: Ràng wǒ zài kànkan.
items.en: B: Let me look around some more.
